# The Reinforcements
[italic]Report from the envoy at Lantern Post to the council of the Astraeus Solar Federation, held until it can be sent. A copy was filed with the Bench.[/italic]
To the council:
You asked me to confirm what we suspected. I can.
There is no [color=cyan]Trans-Solarian Federation[/color]. It ended in the last great war, the one our fleets brought to a close, and its worlds sit on the council now as Sol. Our records closed its account longer ago than the [italic]Halcyon[/italic] has been in Colossus. Its fleets were disbanded or surrendered. The [italic]Halcyon[/italic] is not on the list of surrendered ships. She is on the list of ships lost before the war began.
And yet the [italic]Halcyon[/italic] flies. Her marines are fed, armed and paid. Every few weeks, Federation transports come in from the edge of the sector and dock with her: troopships, cryo barges and supply haulers, with fresh crews and sealed orders from Federation High Command.
We cannot find where they come from. They come out of [textlink="the Unmooring" link="WGLoreUnmooring"] on bearings that lead nowhere. Their logs show departure dates that do not agree with each other, or with ours. Their crews speak of the war as though it is still being fought, though not always the same war. One draft named a President who, by our records, died in the schism. Another had never heard of the USSP.
I raised this with the Colonel once. The Colonel heard me out, thanked me, and called it enemy disinformation. I have not raised it again. Relations remain cordial.
Our researchers think the Unmooring caught more than the fleet at the edge. Out there, time does not run in a straight line. They believe the reinforcements are the Federation's own past, ships sent long ago that are only now coming out. If they are right, the transports will stop when the past runs out. Nobody can say when that will be.
I have stopped telling the new arrivals. They are about to spend the rest of their lives here. Let them believe someone sent them.
I recommend we keep relations cordial and say nothing further. Whatever the [italic]Halcyon[/italic] is, she is holding the line, and so are they.
